description: This is a Java class file implementing a cache for MongoDB collection futures, utilizing Caffeine caching library and Scala interoperability. It manages cache configurations, retrieval, and invalidation for MongoDB collections.

classes.name: DittoMongoCollectionCache
classes.description: A cache implementation for MongoDB collection futures, parameterized over collection type C, using Caffeine cache and Scala Futures.

methods.name: DittoMongoCollectionCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with configuration parameters for expiry and size limits.

methods.name: getOrElseCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a collection future from cache or creates it if absent, converting between Scala and Java futures.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the cache entry for the specified collection name.

methods.description: Helper method to safely retrieve configuration values, returning an Optional.
